title: CHAPTER 2 : Theory of Demand and Supply
content:
ሰላም ሰላም! ውድ የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች፤ እንኳን ወደ Economics Chapter 2 Part 3 በሰላም መጣችሁ! ዛሬ ደግሞ የትምህርታችንን ማጠቃለያ ክፍል ይዘንላችሁ ቀርበናል። በክፍል 1 እና 2 ስለ Demand እና Elasticity በስፋት ማየታችን ይታወሳል። ዛሬ ደግሞ ከክፍል 2.2 (Theory of Supply) ጀምሮ እስከ ምዕራፉ ማጠቃለያ (Market Equilibrium) ድረስ ያሉትን ቁልፍ ሀሳቦች፣ የግራፍ ስዕሎች፣ ሰንጠረዦች እና አዝናኝ የፈተና መስሪያ ስሌቶች (Numerical Examples) በከፍተኛ ጥራት አዘጋጅተንላችኋል። ሳታስቡት Economicsን ቀላል አድርገን እንጨርሰዋለን፤ አብራችሁን ቆዩ!👇👇👇


2.2 Theory of Supply

Supply indicates various quantities of a product that sellers (producers) are willing and able to provide at different prices in a given period of time, other things remaining unchanged.

The law of supply: states that, ceteris paribus, as price of a product increases, quantity supplied of the product increases, and as price decreases, quantity supplied decreases. It tells us there is a positive relationship between price and quantity supplied.

👉 • አቅርቦት (Supply) ማለት አምራቾች ወይም ነጋዴዎች በተወሰነ ጊዜ እና በተለያዩ የዋጋ ደረጃዎች ለገበያ ማቅረብ የሚፈልጉት እና የሚችሉት የዕቃ ወይም የአገልግሎት መጠን ነው።
• ሕገ-አቅርቦት (Law of Supply)፦ ሌሎች ነገሮች እንደተጠበቁ ሆነው (Ceteris Paribus)፣ የዕቃ ዋጋ ሲጨምር የሚቀርበው ዕቃ መጠን ይጨምራል፤ ዋጋ ሲቀንስ ደግሞ የሚቀርበው ዕቃ መጠን ይቀንሳል። በመሆኑም በዋጋ እና በሚቀርበው መጠን መካከል Direct (Positive) Relationship አለ።
• (በቀላሉ... ነጋዴ ዋጋ ሲጨምር ትርፍ ስለምታገኝ አብዝተህ ለገበያ ታወጣለህ፤ ዋጋ ሲወርድ ደግሞ ዕቃህን ጎተራ ውስጥ ታጉራለህ!)

👉 • Supply Schedule (የአቅርቦት ሰንጠረዥ)፦ በተለያዩ የዋጋ ደረጃዎች የሚቀርበውን ዕቃ በሰንጠረዥ የሚያሳይ ነው።
• Supply Curve (የአቅርቦት መስመር)፦ ሰንጠረዡን በግራፍ መልክ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ከግራ ወደ ቀኝ ወደ ላይ የሚወጣ Upward Sloping መስመር ነው።
• Market Supply (የገበያ አቅርቦት)፦ በገበያ ውስጥ ያሉትን ሁሉንም አቅራቢዎች (Sellers) ያቀረቡትን መጠን በአግድም በመደመር (Horizontal Addition) የሚገኝ አጠቃላይ አቅርቦት ነው።


2.2.2 Determinants of Supply

Apart from the change in price which causes a change in quantity supplied, the supply of a particular product is determined by:
i) Price of inputs (cost of inputs): An increase in input prices (labour, raw materials) increases cost of production, shifting supply curve to the left.
ii) Technology: Technological advancement enables firms to produce more at lower cost, shifting supply curve outward (to the right).
iii) Prices of related goods: Changes in relative prices of alternative goods affect supply allocation.
iv) Sellers' expectation of future price: If sellers expect prices to rise in the future, they decrease current supply.
v) Taxes & Subsidies: Taxes increase costs and decrease supply; subsidies decrease costs and increase supply.
vi) Number of sellers in the market: More sellers increase total market supply.
vii) Weather conditions: Favorable weather boosts agricultural output (shifts supply right); bad weather decreases it.

👉 • የአቅርቦት ወሳኝ ሁኔታዎች (Determinants)፦ ከዕቃው ዋጋ ውጭ የአቅርቦት መስመርን ወደ ቀኝ (Right) ወይም ወደ ግራ (Left) Shift የሚያደርጉ ሁኔታዎች ናቸው፦
• የግብአት ዋጋ (Input Prices)፦ የጥሬ ዕቃ ወይም የሰራተኛ ክፍያ ሲጨምር አቅርቦት ይቀንሳል (Left shift)።
• ቴክኖሎጂ፦ ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂ የምርት ወጪን ስለሚቀንስ አቅርቦትን ይጨምራል (Right shift)።
• ታክስ እና ሰብስዲ፦ መንግሥት ታክስ ሲጥል አቅርቦት ይቀንሳል፤ ድጎማ (Subsidy) ሲያደርግ ግን አቅርቦት ይጨምራል።
• የአየር ሁኔታ (Weather)፦ ጥሩ የአየር ሁኔታ የግብርና ምርትን ይጨምራል።

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ "Change in Quantity Supplied" እና "Change in Supply" እንዳይቀላቀልባችሁ! Change in Quantity Supplied የሚፈጠረው በራሱ በዕቃው ዋጋ ለውጥ ምክንያት ሲሆን በግራፉ ላይ Movement Along the Curve ያሳያል። Change in Supply ግን ከዋጋ ውጭ ባሉ Determinants ምክንያት አጠቃላይ መስመሩን Shift ያደርጋል!


2.2.3 Elasticity of Supply

It is the degree of responsiveness of the supply to change in price. It may be defined as the percentage change in quantity supplied divided by the percentage change in price.

Formula:
Es = (% change in quantity supplied) / (% change in price) = (ΔQ / Q) ÷ (ΔP / P) = (ΔQ / ΔP) * (P / Q)

Like elasticity of demand, price elasticity of supply can be elastic, inelastic, unitary elastic, perfectly elastic, or perfectly inelastic.
• Perfectly Inelastic Supply (Es = 0): Represented by a vertical straight line.
• Perfectly Elastic Supply (Es = ∞): Represented by a horizontal straight line.


Figure 2.6: Perfectly inelastic and perfectly elastic supply curves

👉 • የአቅርቦት ተለጣፊነት (Elasticity of Supply)፦ ዋጋ ሲቀየር የአቅርቦት መጠን ምን ያህል ምላሽ ይሰጣል የሚለውን ይለካል።
• Es = 0 (Perfectly Inelastic)፦ ዋጋ ቢጨምርም ቢቀንስም የሚቀርበው መጠን አይቀየርም (ቀጥ ያለ ቋሚ መስመር)።
• Es = ∞ (Perfectly Elastic)፦ በተወሰነ ዋጋ ላይ ወሰን የሌለው አቅርቦት ይኖራል (ቀጥ ያለ አግድም መስመር)።


2.3 Market Equilibrium

Having seen the demand and supply side of the market, now let's bring demand and supply together so as to see how the market price of a product is determined. Market equilibrium occurs when market demand equals market supply (Qd = Qs).


Figure 2.7: Market equilibrium

Explanation of Market Dynamics:
• At point 'E', market demand equals market supply (Equilibrium point).
• P is the market equilibrium (market clearing) price.
• M is the market equilibrium quantity.
• Market Surplus: Any price greater than P (e.g., P1) leads to excess supply where suppliers offer more than buyers demand (Surplus = HJ).
• Market Shortage: Any price lower than P (e.g., P2) leads to excess demand where buyers want more than suppliers provide (Shortage = GF).

👉 • የገበያ ሚዛን (Market Equilibrium)፦ የገበያ ፍላጎት እና አቅርቦት እኩል የሚሆኑበት ነጥብ (Qd = Qs) ነው።
• Surplus (ትርፍ አቅርቦት)፦ ዋጋ ከመደበኛው ሚዛን (P) በላይ ሲሆን (P1) ነጋዴው አብዝቶ ያቀርባል፤ ገዢ ግን ይቀንሳል (አቅርቦቱ ይተርፋል)።
• Shortage (የዕቃ እጥረት)፦ ዋጋ ከመደበኛው ሚዛን በታች ሲወርድ (P2) ገዢ ይበዛል፤ ነጋዴ ደግሞ ዕቃ ይደብቃል (እጥረት ይፈጠራል)።


Numerical Example: Market Equilibrium Calculations
Given market demand: Qd = 100 - 2P, and market supply: P = (Qs / 2) + 10
a) Calculate the market equilibrium price and quantity.
b) Determine whether there is surplus or shortage at P = 25 and P = 35.

Solution:
a) Finding Equilibrium (Qd = Qs):
First, rearrange supply function in terms of Qs:
P = (Qs / 2) + 10 ⇒ P - 10 = Qs / 2 ⇒ Qs = 2P - 20

Set Qd = Qs:
100 - 2P = 2P - 20
100 + 20 = 2P + 2P
120 = 4P ⇒ P = 30 Birr (Equilibrium Price)

Substitute P = 30 into Qd or Qs:
Q = 100 - 2(30) = 100 - 60 = 40 units (Equilibrium Quantity)

b) Evaluating Conditions at P = 25 and P = 35:
• At P = 25 Birr:
Qd = 100 - 2(25) = 50 units
Qs = 2(25) - 20 = 30 units
Since Qd > Qs (50 > 30), there is a Shortage of 20 units (50 - 30 = 20).

• At P = 35 Birr:
Qd = 100 - 2(35) = 30 units
Qs = 2(35) - 20 = 50 units
Since Qs > Qd (50 > 30), there is a Surplus of 20 units (50 - 30 = 20).

👉 • በፈተና ላይ የ Supply Equation በ 'P' መልክ ከተሰጣችሁ መጀመሪያ ወደ 'Qs' ቀይሩት። ከዚያ Qd = Qs በማድረግ ሚዛኑን ማውጣት በጣም ቀላል ነው!


Effects of Shift in Demand and Supply on Equilibrium

Given demand and supply, equilibrium price and quantity are stable. However, when these market forces shift, equilibrium changes.

i) When Demand Changes and Supply Remains Constant
• Increase in Demand (Shift Right to D1D1): Intersects SS curve at E1, increasing equilibrium price from OP to OP1 and quantity from OM to OM1.
• Decrease in Demand (Shift Left to D2D2): Intersects SS curve at E2, decreasing equilibrium price from OP to OP2 and quantity from OM to OM2.


Figure 2.8: The effect of change in demand on market equilibrium

👉 • አቅርቦት ሳይቀየር ፍላጎት (Demand) ብቻ ወደ ቀኝ ያደገ እንደሆነ የገበያው ሚዛናዊ ዋጋም ሆነ የሚሸጠው መጠን አብረው ይጨምራሉ። ፍላጎት ሲቀንስ ደግሞ ሁለቱም ይቀንሳሉ።


ii) When Supply Changes and Demand Remains Constant
• Increase in Supply (Shift Right to S1S1): Intersects DD curve at E1, reducing equilibrium price from OP to OP1 and increasing quantity from OM to OM1.
• Decrease in Supply (Shift Left to S2S2): Intersects DD curve at E2, raising equilibrium price from OP to OP2 and reducing quantity from OM to OM2.


Figure 2.9: The effect of change in supply on market equilibrium

👉 • ፍላጎት ሳይቀየር አቅርቦት (Supply) ብቻ ሲጨምር ዕቃ ገበያ ላይ ስለሚበዛ ዋጋ ይቀንሳል፤ የሚሸጠው መጠን ግን ይጨምራል። አቅርቦት ሲያንስ ደግሞ ዋጋ ይወደዳል፤ የሚሸጠው መጠን ይቀንሳል።


iii) Effects of Combined Changes in Demand and Supply
• When both demand and supply increase: Quantity definitely increases. Price depends on relative shift magnitudes (If ΔD > ΔS, price rises; if ΔS > ΔD, price falls; if ΔD = ΔS, price remains same).
• When both demand and supply decline: Quantity definitely decreases. Price change depends on relative shift magnitudes.

👉 • ሁለቱም አብረው ሲጨምሩ፦ የሚሸጠው መጠን (Quantity) በእርግጠኝነት ይጨምራል፤ ዋጋው ግን የትኛው በበለጠ መጠን እንደጨመረ ይወሰናል።
